hindsight_build_receipts: Active receipt: ~/.local/state/dotfiles/hindsight-build.json. Successful recipe/image transitions preserve the previous receipt verbatim in private ~/.local/state/dotfiles/hindsight-build-history/<receipt-sha256>.json before replacing it. A changed pin builds the new recipe; arbitrary existing tags require explicit adoption. Failed builds retain the active receipt.
hindsight_installer: scripts/hindsight.sh installs CLI 0.9.2 and missing coding-agent runtime >=0.5.3, builds/reuses the pinned unmodified upstream standalone app and pulls only the GHCR digest-pinned database. --dry-run/check are read-only; --no-start stages without service changes and requires Docker already available. App updates do not restart the database.
restore_order: Install Docker/Compose, NVIDIA drivers/runtime and Python >=3.11. Node/npm and Codex can be restored by the opt-in user-tools installer after rendering.

Render with the private values file. On a replacement machine, restore the original Tailscale identity/defaults with its daemon stopped and the source node offline; never duplicate an active identity.

Load the captured EasyLlama image archives when absent, then install EasyLlama, Tailscale and router lifecycle components; bootstrap selects these before Hindsight. Existing model/cache and database stores are preserved.
Run scripts/tools.sh install to install mise, configured runtimes and versionless user packages; review local Go rebuilds and excluded retired Pi packages.
Start the captured local AI user units, then run scripts/hindsight.sh install as the logged-in destination user. EasyLlama precedes 9router; PostgreSQL and 9router precede Hindsight.
Start a new Codex session after the local services and coding-agent runtime are available.
hindsight_data: Only empty persistent-data directories are created. Database contents and the imported corpus require a separate private backup.
hindsight_images: App: root/home/user/.config/hindsight/build.json pins official upstream commit 48b62ee08170b464f4c42b6f133b7cb798a59b21, docker/standalone/Dockerfile target standalone, PRELOAD_ML_MODELS=false, INCLUDE_LOCAL_MODELS=true (Flashrank retained). HINDSIGHT_IMAGE must be the immutable sha256 image ID backed by ~/.local/state/dotfiles/hindsight-build.json and matching OCI source/revision labels. Source cache: ~/.cache/dotfiles/hindsight/<commit>. Private values update and compose-only rendering use scripts/hindsight.py build-image. A trusted completed parent build may be explicitly adopted using --adopt-iidfile; --archive restores only an image matching an existing verified receipt. Database remains pinned to its GHCR digest.
nas_backup: scripts/backup.sh installs cifs-utils, smbclient, rsync, unzip and zstd; manages bounded /etc/hosts and /etc/fstab blocks; and enables a daily user timer. The rendered nas-backup command first updates the canonical current home mirror, including private credentials and managed dotfiles, then creates Zstandard ultra-level-22 historical .tar.zst restore points from it with Hindsight's native online database export. Home restore defaults to the mirror or accepts a selected historical archive, creates a compressed pre-restore snapshot, and preserves extra live files; Hindsight restore uses the embedded validated export and retention defaults to 60 days.
